notes: Registry outcomeMeasuresModule contains only cardiovascular and renal composite outcomes. Hypoglycaemia is reported in adverseEventsModule.otherEvents (non-serious adverse events): Linagliptin 1022/3494 and Placebo 1003/3485. These printed event counts differ from served ai=1036 and ci=1024; denominators agree. The held article abstract reports 1036 and 1024 patients with one or more episodes of hypoglycemia, a broader outcome. Registry seriousEvents separately reports Hypoglycaemia in 28 Linagliptin and 38 Placebo patients, and Hypoglycaemic coma in 1 patient per arm. These categories were not summed; no registry total for all hypoglycemia episodes was identified. Registry group ownership and non-serious Hypoglycaemia counts are used under the required registry precedence.
